load_module_by_name: load a Python module or class by its dotted path using load_module with module_name and class_name
instantiate_object_from_spec: instantiate an object from an ObjectSpec config using load_object with class_name and kwargs
build_optimizer_for_model: build an optimizer for a PyTorch model using build_optimizer with per_module config and model parameters
filter_forward_kwargs: filter keyword arguments for a module forward pass using ForwardFilter to match expected parameter names
get_full_class_name: get the fully qualified class name of a Python object using get_full_name returning module.qualname
